body:
I have heard about morning glory containing LSA and have tried making it before but no effects were felt in the past... Recently (4-30-06) I received my 15 gram shipment of morning glory seeds from holland which 'gaurenteed' results.
I ground up seeds in coffee Grinder and soacked in ethanol for about 20 minutes vigurously shaking the whole time... After I strained and layed mush in the sun for the ethanol to evaporate. Once dry I put in Glass Jar with one shot of 80 proof brandy. 3 days I let it soak. I strained mixtured and drank.
Wow nothing at all happened.
